newsitem.title: USA: Chiquita Brands names Steven Warshaw COO.
newsitem.headline: Chiquita Brands names Steven Warshaw COO.

text.p: Chiquita Brands International Inc said Thursday that Steven Warshaw, 43, has been elected president and chief operating officer and a member of the board.
Warshaw, who has been with Chiquita for the past 11 years, will maintain his responsibilities as chief financial officer, the company said.
Most recently he had served as executive vice president, CFO and chief administrative officer of Chiquita.
And the company said Keith Lindner, who has been president and chief operating officer, has assumed a new role as vice chairman of the board.
The company said Robert Kistinger, 44, has been promoted to president and chief operating officer of the Chiquita Banana Group with responsibility for the company's worldwide banana business.
